Alicia Viewstroem is Commander-in-Chief of the Cordelia Army. Regent of the Principality of Cordelia.

She is one of the heroines in Prison Battleship 2.

Personality
Alicia is a talented woman with the dignity, she has excellent politics and military affairs, and has a deep understanding of science and technology.

As the hero of Cordelia's rise, she is extremely popular with her vassals and the people, and at the same time, she is in awe as a true warrior who is loyal to her successor Maya of hers while ruling the country.

She loves Maya Cordelia and supports her in every way, to make her a magnificent Grand Duke, she is also an old friend of Rieri Bishop. Alicia has genuine love and fondness for her cousin Maya. She is willing to get her hands dirty just so her cousin doesn't have to. Furthermore, she is more like a guardian and mother than a cousin's sister.

Alicia is arrogant and very violent, and also looks down on the poor areas of Cordelia.

Appearance
She has blond hair and purple eyes.

History
Background
Alicia is the daughter of the predecessor, Count Leif Viewstroem, younger brother of Grand Duke Jeldo Cordelia. She leads a military power that has great influence on Neo Terra and New Solar.

An old friend of Rieri Bishop., even visiting her marriage in the past, she became the lover of Fritz Anaya. Alicia is also the captain of the Armored Knight Eins unit, which is a unique invention of Cordelia, and she is also known as a brave general who stands on a dangerous front and takes command.

After the assassination of the Count and the Grand Duke (her father and uncle), she became the guardian of her cousin, Maya Cordelia, and has since led Cordelia to become a military power with great influence during the conflict between the Neo Terra and New Solars. Fighting in the second war against the Neo Terra army, she was able to defeat them.

Visual Novels
She uncovered that the archbishop "Dino Dilasso" was an imposter and worked for the Neo Terra Army. Learning that he supported her anti-maya faction, uncle "Basil Charlois".

However, she was in the end knocked out by and captured later on by Rieri Bishop. Rieri worked for "Dino Dilasso", which in reality was Donny Bohgan. She and Maya were put into the Brainwashing Machine of the Battleship Jerkel, and trained.

Giving Donny more political power and the Title of Viscount, after the training was completed they joined his ranks and his group "Die Erde".

TABA Timeline
In a (What if) event, a time rift opens and transports her and Maya Cordelia into the past. They allied with the UFS.

RPGX Timeline
Fuuma Kotaro is training in a Holographic Training Room however, he is transported to the world of Maya and Alice. After saving, Maya from an assassination attempt, he is not sure if the encounter had been a dream. Later on, a Cetus whale is encountered in the depth of space and Alicia and Maya investigate, but Maya is pulled by the creature into the Post-Apocalyptic Future Universe and later normal RPGX Timeline. Now unable to return, Alicia remains.

Donny Bohgan, also appears active during that time, but has not yet used his Brainwashing Machine (Prison) on her.
